name: Children of the Vertical
description: Vantablack Media's most expensive production of the 2210s, a sweeping neural-feed epic spanning three generations of a family climbing GLMZ's social tiers from the Gray Zone to Spire through loyalty, sacrifice, and corporate service. The feed is engineered to trigger genuine emotional catharsis at key story beats — players report weeping during the protagonist's Tier 4 certification sequence as if it were their own achievement. The film functions as aspirational mythology for corponation culture and was bundled free with all new BCI activations for two years.
cultural_impact: The phrase 'climbing vertical' entered common usage as a sincere aspiration for millions of Tier 1-2 residents, significantly increasing voluntary corponation enrollment rates.
story_hooks: The film's emotional architecture was designed by the same team that builds loyalty conditioning for corporate security forces — the methodology is identical.
A the Gray Zone community organizer is using the film's aspirational framework ironically, teaching people to identify exactly which emotions are being manufactured and why.
The family depicted in the film is fictional, but the Gray Zone location shown in the opening act is real — and the actual residents there want to know who authorized the use of their home.
